finding: Exact-commit pagination evidence must retain and validate response status plus GitHub rate-limit headers for every page; body-only retention cannot distinguish complete retrieval from a collection interrupted by primary or secondary rate limiting.

supports: x-ratelimit-limit, remaining, used, reset, and resource are returned in response headers
primary limit exhaustion returns 403 or 429 with remaining equal to zero
secondary limit exhaustion returns 403 or 429 and may include retry-after
continued requests while rate limited may cause integration banning
secondary rate-limit status cannot be checked prospectively
clients should obey rate-limit and retry guidance rather than treating partial pagination as complete

uncertainty: No authenticated network enumeration was executed in this slice.
Secondary limits are partly undisclosed and cannot be prospectively queried.
Header validation does not independently prove Link-header completeness or absence of the 1000-result filtered-search ceiling.

fail_closed_conditions: zero remaining budget before terminal page

falsification_route: Run the deterministic Node tests in CI.
Capture authenticated exact-commit pagination with raw response headers for every page.
Demonstrate that a retained 403, 429, retry-after, or pre-terminal remaining=0 response is rejected.
Demonstrate that contiguous successful pages with one terminal page and coherent headers are accepted.
Recheck official GitHub API documentation if the documented API version or rate-limit contract changes.
claim_boundary: This slice adds a source-backed validation contract only. It does not claim an authenticated enumeration, workflow result, deployment, runtime behavior, or peer execution.
